extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZT52C9V1S row was selected from the BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S table.
The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 8d99c0b95ddbd62581320fd03378a72d97d914bc201c735536cd50e5f6753113.
The Fig. 1 zener characteristic points are digitized readings from the plotted BZT52C9V1S trace; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no intermediate points were interpolated.

The BZT52C9V1S electrical-characteristics row gives VZ = 8.5 V minimum, 9.1 V nominal, and 9.6 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT is 15 ohm at IZT, maximum ZZK is 100 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, and admissible IZM is 5 mA.

No capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published in the supplied datasheet. The remaining page 3 plots are series-wide typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C9V1S trace and were not assigned component-specific points.
